ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (40) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Совершенствование» (sovershenstvovanie) is 'perfecting' and «самосовершенствование» (samosovershenstvovanie) 'self-perfection'; Kant's «задатки» (zadatki) are 'predispositions'. «Китайский Ши-Кинг» (Kitayskiy Shi-King) is given as 'The Chinese Shijing' as elsewhere in the book, and Luke 9:61–62 is translated from Tolstoy's Russian, with «господи» (gospodi) as 'Lord'.
